questions.q: In the diary, when was the witch's birthday party held at Wendy's house?
questions.explain: 根據日記，派對在 10 月 31 日萬聖節（Halloween）舉行。
questions.passage:
Diary – 31st October
Today was Halloween. There was a birthday party for a witch at Wendy's house. We wore costumes and played games.

questions.q: In the play 'Unhappy Birthdays in Storyland', why was the Little Pig unhappy?
questions.answer: Because the wolf blew his birthday cake and house away.
options: Because Snow White ate his apple.
Because the wolf blew his birthday cake and house away.
questions.explain: 根據戲劇，大灰狼吹走了小豬的生日蛋糕和房子。
questions.passage:
Unhappy Birthdays in Storyland (a short play)
Little Pig: It's my birthday, but I'm so sad. The wolf came. He blew and blew. He blew my birthday cake and my house away!
Dragon: I'm sad too. I tried to blow out the candles on my cake, but I breathed fire and burnt my birthday cake!

questions.q: In the fable 'The Stomach and Other Body Parts', why did the hands, mouth and teeth stop working?
questions.answer: They thought the stomach was lazy and did nothing.
options: They thought the stomach was lazy and did nothing.
The brain told them to sleep.
questions.explain: 根據寓言故事，手、嘴和牙齒以為胃（stomach）很懶惰不工作，所以罷工。
questions.passage:
The Stomach and Other Body Parts
The hands, the mouth and the teeth were angry. 'The stomach is lazy. It does nothing!' they said. So they stopped working, and no food went into the stomach. Soon the whole body felt weak and tired. They learnt that the stomach digests food and gives energy to the whole body. Every part of the body is important, and they must work together.

questions.q: What lesson does the fable 'The Stomach and Other Body Parts' teach us?
questions.answer: Every part of the body is important and must work together.
options: Hands are more important than eyes.
Every part of the body is important and must work together.
questions.explain: 當手和嘴不把食物送進胃裏，全身都變得虛弱無力，說明身體各部分必須分工合作。

questions.q: In the comic strip about David, his father and the donkey, trying to please everyone made them carry the donkey in the end.
questions.explain: 父子二人不斷聽別人批評而改變騎驢的方式，最後竟抬着驢走，說明不能盲目討好所有人。
questions.passage: David and his father walk to the market with their donkey. People say, 'Why don't you ride it?' So David rides. Others say, 'Poor father!' Then the father rides. Later they both ride. People say, 'Poor donkey!' They try to please everyone. In the end, David and his father carry the donkey.
